BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.

2. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
